blocks.text: Light dependent resistor (LDR) aisa resistor hai jis ki resistance light intensity (roshni ki shiddat) barhne par kam hoti hai. Isi property (khoobi) ki wajah se ise photo resistor bhi kehte hain. LDR aam taur par cadmium sulphide jaise semiconductor material se banta hai, jo insulating plate par ek khaas pattern (naqshe) mein jamaya jata hai.

LDR ka principle (usool) yeh hai ke roshni parne par material ki conductivity barh jati hai. Andhere mein semiconductor mein bohat kam free electrons (charge carriers) hote hain, is liye resistance zyada hoti hai. Jab roshni ke photons material par parte hain to bahar wale orbits ke electrons ko energy dete hain aur unhein bijli guzarne ke liye azaad kar dete hain. Is se LDR ki resistance kam ho jati hai. LDR par jitni roshni pare utne free electrons bante hain; kam roshni se kam free electrons aur zyada resistance. Resistance ki is tabdeeli ko naap kar circuits mein roshni ki amount (kitni roshni hai) sense (mehsoos) ki jati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is paragraph mein do dafa "free elections" chhapti hai; murad free electrons hai. Upar hum ne sahi lafz electrons likha hai.

LDR light sensing (roshni mehsoos karne wale) circuits mein aam hain, jaise gharon aur sarakon ki automatic (khud-kar) lights (batiyan). LDR aise switch ki tarah kaam karta hai jo shaam (dusk) ko ON aur subah (dawn) ko OFF hota hai.
LDR camera mein maujood roshni ke mutabiq exposure ka waqt (kitni der shutter khula rahe) tay karne mein madad deta hai.

Aam circuit mein LDR voltage divider ka hissa hota hai, jo resistance ki tabdeeli ko measurable (naapne ke qabil) voltage ki tabdeeli mein badalta hai. Yeh voltage microcontroller ya koi aur control circuit padh kar roshni ke mutabiq kaam karta hai. Fig. 9.36 aisa circuit dikhati hai. Andhere mein LDR ki resistance circuit ki standard resistance (100 kΩ) se bohat zyada hoti hai, is liye LDR par voltage drop bohat zyada hota hai, jo voltmeter dikhata hai. Roshni parne par LDR ki resistance bohat kam ho jati hai aur voltmeter kam reading dikhata hai. Yani roshni badalne se voltage badalta hai. Is liye beech wale point B ko NPN transistor ke base ya NOT gate se jor kar light sensor ko switch ki tarah istemal kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf cell (+ oopar) ek zanjeer ke aar paar: nuqta A, kilo-ohm ke darje ki bari resistance, nuqta B, LDR aur earth nuqta G. Voltmeter B se neeche ki taar tak, LDR ke aar paar.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.36 (kitab ki Figure 9.36 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Andhere mein LDR ki resistance bohat zyada hai, is liye us par voltage (voltmeter ki reading) zyada hai. Roshni mein resistance kam ho kar reading kam ho jati hai; B ko transistor ya NOT gate se jor kar switch banta hai.

Inspectors concrete bridge (pul) ki reliability (bharosa) us ki slab mein dabaye gaye carbon fibres ki madad se aasani se jaanch sakte hain, kyun ke carbon fibres bijli guzarte hain (Fig. 9.37 mein carbon fibre sheets ki tasveer hai). Qadam ba qadam:

items: Pehle carbon fibres ki electrical properties (khoobiyan) jaanein: zyada carbon ki wajah se yeh bijli ke achhe conductors hain.
Bridge banate waqt carbon fibres ko concrete slab mein daba dein aur unhein jor kar conductors ka jaal (network) bana dein.
Carbon fibre network mein chhota sa current guzar kar network ki resistance naapein; is se concrete structure (dhanche) ki integrity (salamati) maloom hoti hai.

Network mein laga sensor batata hai ke resistance badal rahi hai ya nahi. Agar resistance waqt ke saath wahi rahe to bridge mazboot hai; agar resistance barhe to concrete kharab ho raha hai ya carbon fibres toot rahe hain.

blocks.text: Bridge ki strength (mazbooti) jaanchne ke aur tareeqe bhi hain: kuch sensors lagatar strain (khinchao), vibration (larzish) aur temperature par nazar rakhte hain, aur andar ke flaws (kharabiyan) jaise daraarein (cracks) ya khali jagahen (voids) ultrasound waves se pakri jati hain.

blocks.prompt: Light dependent resistor (LDR) kya hai? Ise roshni ke liye ON-OFF switch ki tarah kaise istemal kiya ja sakta hai (comprehensive question 9.4)?
blocks.explanation: LDR semiconductor (cadmium sulphide) ka resistor hai jis ki resistance roshni parne par kam hoti hai, kyun ke photons zyada electrons azaad karte hain. Fixed resistor ke saath voltage divider mein LDR par voltage andhere mein zyada aur din mein kam hota hai. Yeh voltage transistor ya NOT gate ko diya jata hai jo lamp ko shaam ko ON aur subah OFF kar deta hai, jaise sarakon ki automatic lights (batiyan).

items: LDR (photo resistor, cadmium sulphide): roshni electrons azaad karti hai, is liye roshni barhne par resistance ghatti hai; andhere mein zyada resistance.
Istemal: automatic lights (shaam ON, subah OFF), camera exposure, 100 kΩ resistor ke saath voltage divider jo transistor ya NOT gate chalaye.
Concrete bridge: carbon fibre network; resistance barhe to daraarein ya kharab fibres; strain, vibration, temperature sensors aur ultrasound bhi.
